orgs.name: XGEN Labs
orgs.description: A world-model company founded in 2026 and operated as XGEN Labs Limited in Hong Kong; in September 2026 it announced Generative World Simulation, pairing DAO, an engine that keeps a shared world state with autonomous characters, with JING, an open first-person audio-video model built on MiniMax-H3. It has not named its founders or investors publicly; a consumer product is planned for beta in November 2026.
orgs.description_zh: 成立于 2026 年的世界模型公司，以 XGEN Labs Limited（原初之境科技有限公司）在香港运营；2026 年 9 月发布“生成式世界模拟”，由保存共享世界状态与自主角色的引擎 DAO，以及基于 MiniMax-H3 的开源第一人称音视频模型 JING 组成。公司未公开创始人与投资方；计划于 2026 年 11 月开始一款面向消费者的产品内测。

orgs.name: WBench Leaderboard
orgs.description: The public leaderboard of WBench, the multi-turn benchmark for interactive video world models from Fudan University and Meituan's LongCat team: 289 cases scored on video quality, setting adherence, interaction, consistency and physics, with separate Full and Navigation tracks. In October 2026 it listed 44 Navigation and 16 Full entries; several top entries, including XGEN-JING and Murea-Pro, are labelled self-evaluated.
orgs.description_zh: WBench 的公开排行榜。WBench 是复旦大学与美团 LongCat 团队推出的交互视频世界模型多轮评测基准，用 289 个案例从画质、设定遵循、交互、一致性与物理五个方面评分，分为 Full 与 Navigation 两条赛道。2026 年 10 月共有 44 个 Navigation 条目与 16 个 Full 条目，包括 XGEN-JING 与 Murea-Pro 在内的多个领先条目标注为自评结果。
